env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd lgo
logos build -o $WORK/lgo.a .
cd ..
go tool pack p $WORK/lgo.a __.LOGOS
stdout '^logos-facts 3$'
stdout '^fingerprint [0-9a-f]{16}$'
stdout '^comptime Generate [0-9]+$'
stdout '^const Box FF0$'
stdout '^fn Add ParamMutated=1$'
stdout '^fn ReadIface.Name Readonly$'
stdout '^fn Assert AssertTP=1,AssertRTP=0$'
stdout '^constfn GenerateConst [0-9]+$'
! stdout '^lang go$'

cd go
logos build -o $WORK/go.a .
cd ..

cp stdout $WORK/go.facts
grep '^fn GoAssert AssertTP=1,AssertRTP=0$' $WORK/go.facts
grep '^fn ReadAll ParamMutated=0$' $WORK/go.facts
grep '^fn WriteAt ParamMutated=1$' $WORK/go.facts
grep -count=1 '^lang go$' $WORK/go.facts
! grep 'ReceiverMutated' $WORK/go.facts

! grep '^comptime' $WORK/go.facts
! grep '^default ' $WORK/go.facts
! grep '^conforms ' $WORK/go.facts
! grep '^readonly ' $WORK/go.facts

stdout '^logos-facts 3$'

stdout '^fn WriteAt ParamMutated=1,MayYield=1$'
stdout '^lang go$'
cd go
go build -o $WORK/go-wasm-plain.a .
cd ..

stdout '^lang go$'
stdout '^fn ReadAll MayYield=[01]$'
stdout '^fn WriteAt MayYield=[01]$'
! stdout 'ParamMutated'
env GOOS=
env GOARCH=
cd go
logos build -O=0 -o $WORK/go-o0.a .
cd ..

stdout '^logos-facts 3$'
stdout '^fn GoAssert AssertTP=1,AssertRTP=0$'

cd ..

stdout '^logos-facts 3$'

stdout '^lang go$'

cd go
go build -o $WORK/go-build.a .
cd ..

stdout '^logos-facts 3$'
stdout '^fn GoAssert AssertTP=1,AssertRTP=0$'
stdout '^lang go$'
! stdout 'ParamMutated'
cd go
go tool compile -logos.gofacts -p example.com/go -o $WORK/go-flagged.a wire.go
cd ..

stdout '^logos-facts 3$'
stdout '^fn ReadAll ParamMutated=0$'
stdout '^fn WriteAt ParamMutated=1$'
cd mut

stdout '^imp-mut: 14$'

stderr '\[correctness::const_view_mutation\]'

-- lgo/go.mod --
module example.com/lgo

go 1.27

-- lgo/wire.lgo --
package wire

import "comptime"

type Box struct {
	F0 const []int
}

type ReadIface interface {
	const Name() string
}

type Row struct {
	X int
}

func Add(p *int) {
	*p = 1
}

func Assert[T any](x any) T {
	return x.(T)
}

func Generate[T any]() int {
	const for _, f := range comptime.Fields[T]() {
		return f.Index
	}
	return 0
}

const func GenerateConst(x int) int {
	return x + 1
}

-- go/go.mod --
module example.com/go

go 1.27

-- go/wire.go --
package wire

func GoAssert[T any](x any) T {
	return x.(T)
}

func GetItems() []int {
	return []int{1, 2, 3}
}

func ReadAll(b []byte) int {
	n := 0
	for _, v := range b {
		n += int(v)
	}
	return n
}

func WriteAt(b []byte, v byte) {
	b[0] = v
}

type Counter struct {
	N int
}

func (c *Counter) Inc() {
	c.N++
}

func NewCounter() *Counter {
	return &Counter{}
}

-- mut/go.mod --
module example.com/mut

go 1.27

-- mut/mut.go --
package mut

type Acc struct {
	N int
}

func (a *Acc) Add(n int) {
	a.N += n
}

-- imp/go.mod --
module example.com/imp

go 1.27

require example.com/go v1.0.0

replace example.com/go => ../go

-- imp/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/go"
)

func main() {
	s := wire.GetItems()
	s[0] = 9
	fmt.Println("imp-mut:", s[0]+s[1]+s[2])
	fmt.Println("imp-assert:", wire.GoAssert[int](any(7)))
}

-- imp/badinc/main.lgo --
package main

import "example.com/go"

func main() {
	c := wire.NewCounter()
	var view const *wire.Counter = c
	view.Inc()
}

-- quiet/go.mod --
module example.com/quiet

go 1.27

-- quiet/quiet.go --
package quiet

func Make() []int {
	return make([]int, 8)
}
